item.title: Gambonanza Complete Walkthrough - Every Stage From First Board to Final Boss
item.description:
THE SHAPE OF A RUN

A Gambonanza run is 5 stages of 5 games each, so 25 games total. The 5th game of every stage is a boss checkpoint. You start on a 5x5 board with 3 pieces, and the board grows by a row after each stage you clear. This walkthrough follows that structure from start to finish.

AStart here if you want the whole run mapped out. Pair it with the Boss Guide for the fight-by-fight detail.

Phase 1: Stage 1-2, Opening on the 5x5 Board

Goal

Build a working economy and a coherent Gambit direction before the first boss arrives.
